label: Applying directly to a Spanish private university for autumn 2027

milestones.label: Each private university's own admission rounds
milestones.note: IE, Navarra, ESADE, Deusto and Comillas run their own tests, interviews and rolling rounds from the autumn before entry, and make conditional offers on predicted grades. Earlier rounds have more places.

milestones.label: IE University Round 2 closes
milestones.note: An example of the private calendar. IE's other 2027-28 rounds close 18 September 2026 (already passed), 6 November 2026 and 5 March 2027; after that, from May 2027, only if places remain.

milestones.label: Universidad de Deusto applications for 2027–2028
milestones.note: A second example, and a short one: Deusto takes undergraduate applications for 2027–2028 only from 2 to 30 November 2026.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Confirms a conditional offer. The university may still ask for UNEDasiss accreditation for enrolment.

notes: IE's rounds and Deusto's window were read for this route. Navarra, Esade (online test weekly, October to June), Comillas and CEU San Pablo publish their own.
